store.description: Type an equation and see the curve. Plot several functions at once, pan and zoom, trace values, find roots and save the graph as a picture.
features: Plot y = f(x) for several functions at once
sin, cos, tan, sqrt, log, ln, abs, powers and constants
Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset
Hover to trace every visible function at once
Automatic roots (x-intercepts) in the current view
Save the graph as a PNG
